description: Check the stored audit-event hash chain for a known FreeSign envelope ID. Recomputes event hashes, links, and sequence continuity, and cross-checks a signer-attested head when its signature verifies. Returns the verdict and raw evidence for independent verification. Chain integrity alone does not establish legal validity or inspect PDF content.
name: verify_audit_chain

attested_audit_chain_head_hash.description: The audit-chain head derived from the signer-signed v2 final payload (G-01), fed into the verdict's head cross-check. NULL until the envelope is finalized.

attested_head_signature_verified.description: True when the final-payload signature carrying the attested head was re-verified against the signer's on-file public key. False when not finalized or the signature did not verify.

broken_at.description: seq of the first broken event, or null (also null for a head_mismatch — no single event is at fault).

head_checked.description: True when an attested head was supplied and cross-checked against the recomputed chain.

head_match.description: Result of the head cross-check, or null when no attested head was available.

title: Verify audit chain
